CSC PULSESTRIKE M - pivots and axes (metres, as drawn in Minecraft = model x 2.60; Minecraft / glTF frame: Y up, front -Z)
base:  origin = bottom centre of the base (standing fixture); hung under a truss the whole fixture is turned 180 degrees about Z
head:  tilt pivot (0.0000, 0.5772, 0.0000) (in the base frame), tilt = rotation about +X, 190 degrees in total, positive raises the beam; head OBJ vertices are relative to this pivot
beam:  origin (-0.0000, 0.1625, 0.0000) (head frame), axis (0.0000, 1.0000, 0.0000), lens radius 0.4683, zoom 20-70 degrees
